subtests.name: Initial paint of all canvases across multiple branches and sibling inner canvases runs in reverse shadow-including tree order
Repainting inner_b_1 fires paint events in reverse shadow-including tree order (inner_b_1 before outer_b)
Repainting sibling inner canvases in outer_b fires in reverse shadow-including tree order
Simultaneous repaints across disjoint branches fire in reverse shadow-including tree order
Drawing operations in nested canvas onpaint should not cause outer onpaint to fire again
